about: Renders one field box that contains fields, marks and addons in one row or in several rows. Every item takes its own width, so a mark of any width never covers the text.

addons.about: An addon is `filled` by default, with the surface one step darker than the box. A `plain` addon has no fill and keeps its divider.
addons.title: Addon looks

align.about: The marks on the middle of the box, and on the first line of a field that runs to several lines.
align.title: Alignment

note: Leave the parcel at the side door. The front bell is broken.
plan: Team plan, set by your organisation

card.about: Four fields in one row: the number, the expiry month and year, and the security code. A divider separates two adjacent fields, and the slash mark between month and year replaces one. Each field has its own name. A field with a `size` attribute keeps that width.
card.title: Card details

cardNumber.about: The example formats the number in groups of four as the reader types, with no mask library. Any component that renders an input and forwards its ref works as a field.
cardNumber.title: Card number

counter.about: A mark after the field counts the characters against `maxLength`. The count describes the field.
counter.title: Counter

coupon.about: A button in a mark applies the code. A press on the button keeps its own behaviour.
coupon.title: Button

locked.about: A disabled `Fieldset.Root` disables every field inside it, and the box takes the disabled look. The marks dim with the box, because they are part of the inactive group.
locked.title: Disabled

password.about: A button in a mark shows and hides the password and reports its state with `aria-pressed`. A press on the lock mark focuses the field.
password.title: Password

payment.about: The same four fields in two rows: the number on the first row, and the expiry and security code on the second. A divider separates the rows. Every item of the group sits inside a row.
payment.title: Card details in rows

phone.about: A select in a start addon picks the country code. A press on the chevron opens the list where the browser supports it.
phone.title: Country code

search.about: A search mark before the field and a keyboard hint after it. Both marks are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
search.title: Search

website.about: An addon at each end: the protocol as text and the domain as a select. Each addon reaches the box's edge and takes its corners.
website.title: Addons

size.about: Every size. The height reads the control scale and the inset is one size smaller, the same as the input's.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: Rest, keyboard focus, read-only and invalid. The box takes its state from the field inside it: a ring on focus, a dashed edge when read-only, and the error edge when invalid.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the box's edge and focus ring from its palette.
status.title: Statuses

title: Input group

variant.about: The three looks of the box, the same as the input's. The flushed look draws the block-end edge alone and keeps the smallest inset.
variant.title: Looks
